metadata.title: A note on the Chern-Yamabe flow on compact Hermitian manifolds with negative Gauduchon degree
metadata.abstract: In this note, we prove that on a compact Hermitian manifold with negative Gauduchon degree, the Chern-Yamabe flow introduced in our recent work [13] converges to the solution of prescribed Chern scalar curvature problem, provided that the candidate curvature function is nonpositive and not identically zero.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 负度数 Chern–Yamabe 流收敛
analysis.workSummary: 证明紧 Hermitian 流形在 Gauduchon 度数为负时，作者此前引入的 Chern–Yamabe 流收敛到指定 Chern 标量曲率问题的解。
analysis.breakthrough: 用几何流实现负 Gauduchon 度数下的指定 Chern 标量曲率。
analysis.limitations: 指定曲率函数必须非正且不恒为零；结论不覆盖正度数或变号曲率。
